reviewer_lens: directory layout + repo topology + kind/scope/concept BNF placement

findings.claim: PR title asserts templates centralized under registry/, but registry/capability-templates/ does NOT exist on disk post-merge.
findings.evidence: `ls /Users/jasonlee/oyatie/registry/capability-templates/` => `No such file or directory`. registry/ root contains only `cross-cutting/`. Diff lists three RENAMED files into registry/capability-templates/* but actual filesystem state lacks the directory.
findings.impact: Structural claim in PR is unverified; rename either failed, was reverted, or path is wrong. Gate validates the schemas without checking destination topology.

findings.claim: Singular `registry/` and plural `registries/` BOTH exist at repo root post-merge — ADR-0115 flat-consolidation incomplete.
findings.evidence: `ls /Users/jasonlee/oyatie/` shows `registries/` and `registry/`. `registries/cross-cutting/artifact-capabilities-registry.json` coexists with PR's `registry/artifact-capabilities-registry.json` — duplicate canonical control-plane file.
findings.impact: Two competing topologies for the same registry concept; downstream readers cannot determine canonical source. Violates kind/scope/concept BNF: one kind = one root.

findings.claim: Three template root directories coexist; PR did not consolidate any.
findings.evidence: `templates/` (root, 13 files), `docs/templates/` (PR modified capability-eval-set-template.yaml et al here, did NOT delete), claimed `registry/capability-templates/` (missing). PR title says 'centralize' but adds a 3rd location while leaving the other two intact.
findings.impact: Centralization claim is false; topology gets worse, not better.

findings.claim: `docs/decisions/specs/` is a topology mistake — duplicates `docs/specs/` and `.omc/scratch/`.
findings.evidence: `find docs/decisions -maxdepth 2 -type d` => specs/ subdir. Holds `deep-dive-oyatie-sst-consolidation.md`, identical name in `docs/specs/` and `.omc/scratch/`. Three copies of same deep-dive across three sub-trees.
findings.impact: Violates one-kind-one-root rule. Decisions/ is ADR scope; specs do not belong there per kind/scope BNF.

findings.evidence: Diff modifies `.omc/.project-memory.json.tmp.02e54f69-...`, `.tmp.1132fddd-...`, `.tmp.4a0c6800-...`, `.tmp.8c4e8f96-...`, `.tmp.d332bcd9-...`, `.tmp.f76fe76c-...`. `.gitignore` does NOT exclude `.tmp.*`. Ephemeral per-session memory should not be version-controlled.
findings.impact: Repo polluted with session-local UUID-suffixed temp files; merge-conflict bait; not canonical layout.

findings.claim: `.omc/scratch/` is unsanctioned location for deep-dive notes.
findings.evidence: `ls .omc/scratch/` shows 11 long-form markdown artifacts (deep-dive-oyatie-sst-consolidation.md, hyperscaler-best-practices, lts-versions-verified, etc.). Not referenced by `docs/AGENTS.md`, root-hub-pointers, or markdown-retirement-policy. Sibling dirs (standards/, plans/, sessions/) appear sanctioned; scratch/ is not.
findings.impact: Knowledge stored outside canonical kind/scope tree; bypasses doc-coverage and markdown-retirement enforcement.

whats_missing: ADR for registries/ vs registry/ singularization (ADR-0115 cited but unfulfilled).
Deletion of `docs/templates/` or explicit role separation from `templates/` and `registry/capability-templates/`.
Naming justification covers `registry/capability-templates/` directory but no justification for keeping competing `registries/cross-cutting/` and `templates/` siblings.

ambiguity_risks.quote: Moves the Foundry capability/eval template fixtures into `registry/capability-templates/` and removes the empty retired directory.
ambiguity_risks.interpretation_a: All capability templates now live in registry/capability-templates/.
ambiguity_risks.interpretation_b: Only the 3 fixtures moved; docs/templates/* and templates/* still hold capability templates.
ambiguity_risks.actual: B is true; A is the misleading impression. Centralization is partial at best, non-existent if directory missing.

verdict_justification: Adversarial mode triggered (2 CRITICAL + 3 MAJOR). PR's structural claim is unverifiable on disk (target directory missing) AND deepens topology fragmentation rather than centralizing. ADR-0115 consolidation regressed: registries/ and registry/ both live. Stowaway .tmp files committed. Schema-validation gates passed because they validate content, not topology — exactly the gap A3 exists to catch.
open_questions: Was the rename reverted post-merge by a follow-up cleanup not in this diff?
Is `registries/cross-cutting/` planned for deletion in a chained PR (#17/#18)?
Does `.omc/scratch/` have a sanction document this reviewer missed?
